# Option names OpenWrt's own sources define, by config, fetched with gh api on 2026-10-08 from
# openwrt/openwrt, openwrt/firewall4, openwrt/odhcpd and openwrt/netifd (default branches). Each block is headed by where it
# came from. TestOpenWrtOptionNamesOnlyTheHooksAreRefused runs the code-execution check over every
# name here and requires that exactly the hooks it names are refused: a rule widened by accident
# shows up as a setting an agent can no longer change.
#
# Format: '# config: source' then the names, space-separated, until a blank line.
